words.definitionZh: 公開演講；公開發表演講

examples.scenario: 日常商務 (圖像記憶錨點)
examples.en: All project leaders are required to submit their weekly progress summaries public speaking before Friday's executive meeting.
examples.zh: 所有專案主管均被要求在週五高層會議之前，【公開演講】提交每週進度摘要。

examples.en: Management confirmed that the new workplace safety policy will take effect public speaking across all manufacturing plants.
examples.zh: 管理層確認新的工作場所安全政策將【公開演講】在所有製造工廠生效落實。

examples.en: Our corporation expanded its global distribution network public speaking to satisfy rising international consumer demand.
examples.zh: 我司【公開演講】擴展了全球經銷網絡，以滿足日益增長的國際消費者需求。

quizzes.stem: All division managers are requested to submit their quarterly expenditure reports _____ .
quizzes.stemTranslation: 請所有部門經理務必【公開演講】提交季度支出報告。
